supersedes.reason: align replay objective and stress semantics with user capital extraction and no-top-up policy

capital_extraction.withdrawal_rule: while equity >= 1.5 * retained_base, withdraw 0.5 * retained_base and record external cashflow
capital_extraction.ruin_rule: on liquidation or equity <= 0, set terminal equity to zero and stop all future trading for that replay

primary_objective.name: cashflow_adjusted_total_wealth
primary_objective.comparison_to_always_flat: candidate objective must exceed ALWAYS_FLAT on validation, leaf_wf, and frozen router_holdout

stress_semantics_override.stress_purpose: report risk frontier, withdrawal retention, terminal equity, and ruin under frozen adverse scenarios; do not erase a positive normal-history route solely because a synthetic scenario fails
stress_semantics_override.historical_path_liquidation: real loss; equity zero; stop; prior withdrawals retained
stress_semantics_override.required_disclosure: every validated candidate publishes baseline and every frozen stress scenario side by side; no hidden composite safety score

selection_semantics.baseline_validation_requirement: cashflow_adjusted_total_wealth positive and greater than ALWAYS_FLAT after frozen costs
selection_semantics.leaf_wf_requirement: same primary objective positive under chronological frozen leaf_wf
selection_semantics.router_holdout_requirement: same primary objective positive under one-shot frozen account router replay
selection_semantics.historical_ruin_allowed_to_pass: only if cumulative withdrawals plus terminal equity still exceed initial deposit and all statistical gates pass; must be explicitly labeled HISTORICAL_RUIN_WITH_WITHDRAWAL_RECOVERY

hashes.hash_method: Set hashes.overlay_hash to null, then compute repository datatruth.HashJSON.
